notes_for_editor: Only source found is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (gatowers.html), stamped March 2016. Its entry gives the name, county, coordinates, elevation and labels only. Searched: the cached NHLR Georgia index (no Cochran tower page), the firetower.org Georgia index (no match), the easternuslookouts Georgia list (no Cochran entry), and two web searches. The searches found only communications towers in Cochran (a proposed 265 ft Verizon lattice tower in a 2020 survey, and a registry listing of a 325 ft structure owned by SBA Structures) and the 1914 Bleckley County courthouse clock tower; none is a forestry lookout, so none is used. Nothing confirms what the GFC 501 label refers to. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports so little. Do not add visit or access claims without a managing-agency source.
